note: How long USCIS says it takes to finish Form N-400 at each field office, in months, copied BY HAND from the official USCIS processing times page (source_url). The app never fetches this from USCIS; a person checks it and updates checked_on. These months are when the case is usually finished, not the interview date. Entries with "sample": true are made-up examples: learners never see them (admins and dev only). See content/uscis/README.md.
